result.notes: Notion API is self-serve: any user (even on a free personal workspace) can create an internal integration and generate a personal access token / installation token in minutes, no payment or approval needed for internal use. Public (multi-workspace) integrations use OAuth2 and can optionally be listed in the Notion Marketplace, which does require review, but that only gates marketplace distribution, not basic API access. Endpoint count is small (~20-30 REST endpoints: pages, blocks, databases, users, search, comments), consistent with apis.guru's 13-endpoint OpenAPI spec. Notion also publishes an official hosted remote MCP server (developers.notion.com/docs/mcp), separate from the popular community makenotion/notion-mcp-server GitHub repo.
result.one_liner: Notion is an all-in-one workspace/notes/wiki/project-management app with a REST API for reading and writing pages, databases, and blocks.
